text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Last night... a white rabbit appeared in my dream
and gave me a riddle...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "‘Why are bearded seals and set squares such good friends?’ you ask—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I couldn't figure out the answer...
I was so curious I couldn't sleep...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Obsessing over the answer to the riddle,
Manhattan Cafe seems to have ended up
lacking sleep...
